# fptcloud_backup_native_volume_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the volume backup jobs of a VPC.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_backup_native_volume_jobs" "all" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the job with this exact name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jobs` (List of Object) The volume backup jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `next_run` (String)
- `schedule_enabled` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `volume_ids` (List of String)
